summary: NEW REGISTRATION — status NOT_YET_RECRUITING. Sponsor: Fondazione Ricerca e Innovazione Cardiovascolare ETS. Conditions: Coronary Artery Disease, Coronary Stenosis, Coronary Restenosis, Coronary Atherosclerosis, Vascular Remodeling. Interventions: . Type OBSERVATIONAL, enrollment 200. Start 2026-10, primary completion 2027-01. To characterize, using paired coronary computed tomography angiography (CCTA), longitudinal changes in coronary atherosclerotic plaque, lumen dimensions, and vessel remodeling between baseline and mid-term follow-up in de novo coronary lesions successfully treated with drug-coated balloon (DCB)-only angioplasty. No additional imaging examination, intervention, or clinical visit is mandated by the study protocol.
title: The PICCOLETO XIII REVEAL-DCB Cohort A Study (NCT07868523)

triage.summary: New Italian observational registration (PICCOLETO XIII REVEAL-DCB Cohort A, 200 patients) using paired CCTA to characterize longitudinal plaque and vessel remodeling after drug-coated balloon treatment.
triage.why_it_matters: Another trial using serial CCTA plaque quantification as an endpoint; potential customer for quantitative plaque core-lab services.
